title: Ottomans defeat the Safavids at Chaldiran
summary: Sultan Selim I's army, using artillery and firearms, defeated the cavalry of Shah Ismail I of Persia in northwestern Iran.
reason: The Sunni Ottomans feared the spread of Safavid Shia influence among the Turkmen tribes of Anatolia.
significance: It fixed the Ottoman-Persian frontier for generations and deepened the Sunni-Shia divide between the two empires.
